name: import-chrome-history
description: The import pane imports the staged Chrome fixture twice. The first run adds 4 visits to the Default profile and 3 to the Work profile that the import creates. The second run adds none, because every visit is already there. The command bar then offers Quokka field notes from the Default profile's history, and it does not offer Wombat burrow plans, which belong to Work. The history page lists the Quokka visits. The History files are packed at stage time from fixtures/import/chrome/basic/*/history.json.

actions.note: Atrium frontmost, or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no import rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.import-card[data-source="chrome"] .import-run'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.pattern: Atrium: import history added 4 visits to profile Default
actions.note: the javascript:, 200-day and subframe rows are left out

actions.pattern: Atrium: import history added 3 visits to profile profile-
actions.note: the Work profile loaded and took its own visits, in its own created profile

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.import-card[data-source="chrome"] .import-run'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.pattern: Atrium: import history added 0 visits to profile Default
actions.note: The second run adds no visit
The omnibox offers the imported page
evidence: the imported history row in the command bar
control: Work's history must not land in Default

actions.expression: (() => { let n = 0; const walk = (root) => { for (const el of root.querySelectorAll('*')) { if (el.id === 'link' && el.getAttribute('title') === 'Quokka field notes') { n += 1; } if (el.shadowRoot) { walk(el.shadowRoot); } } }; walk(document); return String(n); })()
actions.note: One entry per day, four days
evidence: the imported visits on the history page
